title: Fire-rate cooldown for auto-fire
description: Hold-to-fire spawns a bullet every frame. Add a SHOT_COOLDOWN const and per-player timer (Res<Time>-based) in shoot::shoot; spawn only when the cooldown elapses. Headless test: two consecutive frames of held input spawn fewer bullets than before / exactly one within the window.
close_reason: ShotCooldown component + cool_down system; shoot fires at most once per 0.2s SHOT_COOLDOWN; (cool_down, shoot).chain ordering; 2 new tests, 13/13 green, clippy clean

title: Despawn bullets when they leave the screen
description: Bullets currently fly forever. Despawn each Bullet when its Sprite bounds exit the camera view (reuse cursor->world camera math for bounds, or a despawn-distance const from origin). Headless tests in src/shoot.rs: keep a bullet in view, remove one from view.
close_reason: despawn_offscreen removes bullets outside the camera's world rect (origin-centered half-size math); 2 tests: keeps on-screen, despawns off-screen; 11/11 green, clippy clean

title: Spawn enemies that chase the player
description: Spawn hostile entities around the play area on a timer that move toward the player. New module (e.g. src/enemies.rs) following the player.rs template: component marker, chase system with a SPEED const, headless World tests (advance Time, assert distance shrinks).

description: Player is drawing own sprites/sounds and learning Bevy. Needs: assets/ subfolders (sprites, sounds) actually tracked by git (empty dirs are invisible to git, so add .gitkeep), and Bevy 'dev' feature enabled in Cargo.toml for asset hot-reloading while iterating on art. No sprite wiring yet - waits for first actual asset.

title: Shoot bullets toward aim direction

close_reason: Bullets spawn from player along aim on click/hold, move via move_bullets; 4 headless tests; 9/9 suite green, clippy clean

title: Player aims at mouse cursor
